@graph.name: Do I need a Restaurant365 alternative to use voice ordering?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Restaurant365 already plans your orders and sends them to your vendors. Voice ordering sits beside it, for any distributor of yours that has our app: you say that order aloud instead of calling it in.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Restaurant365?

acceptedAnswer.text: We are not a Restaurant365 competitor at bookkeeping, stock counts, schedules or payroll: we do none of those. We do one smaller job: an order you say to your distributor, with every item checked by you before sending. If that job is what sent you searching for a Restaurant365 alternative, adding it may be all you need.

@graph.name: Do VoiceOrder Solutions and Restaurant365 connect, and what about POs?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They are not linked in any way, and each company supports only its own product. Nothing you say in our app becomes a Restaurant365 purchase order, so Restaurant365 never sees that order. For that distributor, the order skips your Restaurant365 approvals, and there is no PO to receive the delivery against or to match the invoice to. If your team checks every delivery against its PO, weigh that trade before you move one distributor's orders to voice.

@graph.name: Restaurant365's AI already drafts my purchase orders. Why speak one?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a vendor on EDI, keep the AI draft: it goes straight into their system. For a distributor you call or message, that draft still has to be phoned in, or emailed for someone to read. In our app you speak it from their guide and look over the lines yourself before it is sent.

@graph.name: Can every supplier I buy from be reached this way?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only distributors that give you our app. Restaurant365 can email a PO to any vendor with an address on file, and send by EDI to select vendors. We cannot. Keep sending through Restaurant365 for everyone else, and ask your other distributors whether they have it.

@graph.name: What if a line comes out different from what I said?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every line is on screen before you send, so that is the moment to correct it: swap the item, change the amount, or take the line out. Checking those lines is what protects the order, so skimming them can let an error slip past. We give no order number to orders phoned in or left on voicemail, only to those sent in the app.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The account and your guide are set up by your distributor. If yours does not offer it, or you are not certain, write to us and we will find out who to talk to. Most restaurants are ordering in the app the same day it is set up. On cost, check with your distributor, as they are the ones who provide the app. Our site shows no price, and Restaurant365 gives quotes instead of a public price list.
